messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick sync: need an updated battlecard for the benchmark/webinar focused on competitive claims vs CloudX and LLM APIs. Keep it punchy.

Omar (Growth): One-line goal: 'Show measurable econ + safe SLAs' — that's our AB test headline.

Ellen (Product): Bench pulls: RAG: 28% lower per-token; p95 220ms vs 320ms. Chat: 18% lower; p95 90ms vs 140ms. Use as proof bullets.

Diego (Sales): SDR needs: 1) 30s script, 2) 3 rebut lines, 3) pilot CTA. I'll take the script.

Priya (Marketing): Draft front-of-card:
- Claim: 'Inference-first routing cuts real spend 20-35% vs managed endpoints'
- Why: 'Routing + caching + batching + fallback variants'
- Proof: 'Bench: RAG 28% cost delta; p95 220ms v 320ms'
- CTA: '30m pilot + migration support'

Omar (Growth): Add 'graceful degradation' line: "keeps serving under noisy-tenant spikes". That's a big ops win.

Ellen (Product): Also include short migration pathway slide: ingest model artifacts -> validate perf -> pilot in Dedicated pool. Two-week timeline.

bench-bot: Uploaded bench summary: https://drive.redwood/bench/summary_v3.csv

Diego (Sales): Rebut lines draft: 1) 'Cloud endpoints hide unit economics' 2) 'Quantization alone isn't enough; we combine tactics' 3) 'We provide SLA-preserving fallbacks.'

Priya (Marketing): Good. I'll produce a 1-page PDF and SDR email templates today, then send to legal for numeric claim signoff.

Omar (Growth): Also set inbound routing: messages with 'cost' -> Growth queue; 'latency' -> Solutions; 'pilot' -> Sales. Auto-reply requests workload type.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks team — will post the draft here by 6pm PT. :rocket:
